爱莎贝儿-144CM-M 粉肤 AHR023 诹访部晴香Suwabe Haruka-欺负小白兔
她像小白兔一样软糯，白得透亮，碰一下就轻轻发抖。
真想把她圈进怀里，故意用指尖一点点蹭过她耳后、颈侧。
看她眼睛湿湿地瞪过来，嘴上小声骂着讨厌啦，身子却越贴越近。
越是想逃，越是可爱。
越是欺负，越想再欺负一点。
身型：144CM-M 粉肤

Elsa Babe-144CM-M Pink AHR023 Suwabe Haruka-Teasing the Little Rabbit
She's as soft and delicate as a little rabbit, her skin so fair it's translucent, and she trembles slightly at the slightest touch.
I really want to pull her into my arms, deliberately tracing the back of her ears and the side of her neck with my fingertips.
Seeing her glare at me with wet eyes, muttering "I hate you!" while her body draws ever closer.
The more she tries to escape, the cuter she becomes.
The more I tease her, the more I want to tease her.
Body type: 144CM-M with Pink skin tone.
